description: Implementation of MessageControl class handling message dispatching, client management, and control interfaces within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: MessageControlImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing message control functionalities, including client management, message dispatching, and control interface exposure.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: Inner class representing a worker thread that calls the Dispatch method repeatedly.

classes.name: MessageSettings
classes.description: Singleton class managing message settings loaded from MessageUnit.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets or replaces the callback for message collection, managing thread state accordingly.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Adds an instance with a specific ID to the message client.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Removes an instance with a specific ID from the message client.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables message types for specific categories and modules.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Retrieves current message control settings as an iterator.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Processes incoming messages and invokes the callback with message data.
